Senses.Explanation: Pang Yun’s four-line verse says that protecting life requires killing, that peace comes after killing is exhausted, and that grasping this meaning is an iron boat floating on water. Later masters raise the verse and question what its killing means. Pang Yun’s sequence places the iron boat after “grasp this meaning”; later records quote the verse, reject particular identifications of what is killed, or ask how the impossible boat can float.
